categories.main_business_segments: Haibo Heavy Engineering Science and Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the bridge steel structure engineering sector, encompassing manufacturing, installation, technical research, process design, and technical services related to bridge steel structures. Their products include various bridge types such as suspension bridges, cable-stayed bridges, beam bridges, arch bridges, and steel-concrete composite beams. The company also explores diversified business areas supported by national policies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including computer layout, automatic cutting, CNC drilling, and automated welding with full-automatic double-arc double-wire submerged arc welding lines. They focus on process control and precision manufacturing to ensure high-quality steel structure components. Innovative installation technologies such as intelligent adjustable welding, BIM modeling, and specialized lifting and pushing methods are also key. The company is advancing digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing with equipment like welding robots and hydraulic assembly machines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are large state-owned road and bridge general contractors and government-authorized infrastructure investors. The company serves municipal construction, water-crossing bridges, highways, high-speed railways, and large-scale transportation infrastructure projects. Their major markets include urban elevated roads and large-span highway and railway steel structure bridges. The top five customers accounted for over 55% of sales, indicating a concentrated customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: Haibo Heavy Engineering operates across more than 20 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions in China, with significant revenue contributions from South China, Central China, East China, and Northwest China. The company is headquartered in Wuhan, Hubei Province, which provides strategic transportation advantages. They are also actively seeking overseas emerging markets to diversify their geographic footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and installation of bridge steel structures. They procure raw materials such as steel independently, manage production, and provide integrated project management and installation services directly to clients or general contractors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes steady operations, digital transformation, and internal efficiency improvements. R&D focuses on innovative construction technologies, automation, and intelligent manufacturing equipment. They hold numerous patents and collaborate with academic institutions to enhance technological capabilities. Future plans include expanding market development, enhancing project management, and exploring diversified business lines aligned with national infrastructure policies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through contract-driven project sales of bridge steel structure engineering services, including design, manufacturing, installation, and maintenance. The company wins projects mainly via public and invited bidding, with sales recognized based on project progress. They also generate minor revenue from other business activities and receive government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned in the second tier of the domestic bridge steel structure construction industry, competing with large state-owned enterprises like China Railway Baoji Bridge Group and China Railway Shanhaiguan Bridge Group in the first tier. Haibo Heavy Engineering has strong market competitiveness in municipal elevated steel box girder bridges and maintains a solid position in specialized bridge types but has relatively weaker capabilities in mega-scale projects compared to first-tier firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 419.6 million, a slight increase of 1.07% year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders surged by 280.37% to RMB 23 million. Total assets stood at about RMB 1.54 billion, with equity of RMB 1.06 billion. The company has shown positive cash flow from operations and maintains a stable financial position despite industry challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haibo Heavy Engineering emphasizes high-quality, precision manufacturing and advanced installation technologies to ensure superior bridge steel structure performance. Their integrated project management and digital transformation initiatives enhance efficiency and cost control. The company’s extensive patent portfolio and innovative construction methods provide competitive differentiation, enabling them to deliver complex, large-span bridge projects with high safety, durability, and environmental standards.
